name: drawcode-workspace
description: Repository entry point: install and test the core library and the VS Code extension with one command.

scripts.postinstall: npm install --prefix typescript --no-audit --no-fund && npm install --prefix editors/vscode --no-audit --no-fund
scripts.test: npm test --prefix typescript && npm test --prefix editors/vscode
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix typescript && npm run typecheck --prefix editors/vscode
